# teams_meeting_branding_policy (Resource)

Manages the MeetingBrandingPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsMeetingBrandingPolicy / Get-CsTeamsMeetingBrandingPolicy / Set-CsTeamsMeetingBrandingPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsMeetingBrandingPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `default_theme` (String) Maps to the -DefaultTheme parameter.
- `enable_meeting_background_images` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableMeetingBackgroundImages parameter.
- `enable_meeting_options_theme_override` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableMeetingOptionsThemeOverride parameter.
- `enable_ndi_assurance_slate` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableNdiAssuranceSlate parameter.
- `meeting_background_images` (String) Maps to the -MeetingBackgroundImages parameter.
- `meeting_branding_themes` (String) Maps to the -MeetingBrandingThemes parameter.
- `ndi_assurance_slate_images` (String) Maps to the -NdiAssuranceSlateImages parameter.
- `require_background_effect` (Boolean) Maps to the -RequireBackgroundEffect parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
